lines.zh: 铁剑在肩头晃，沿着村口的栅栏走。
lines.en: My iron sword sways as I pace the village fence.

lines.zh: 六人一队，我走在最外侧那一边。
lines.en: Six of us, and I take the outermost file.

lines.zh: 弩上了弦，我绕到钟楼后面看看。
lines.en: Crossbow strung, I circle behind the bell tower.

lines.zh: 泥路上有脚印，我顺着往北门走。
lines.en: Footprints on the mud; I follow them to the north gate.

lines.zh: 草垛边太安静，我得多转两圈。
lines.en: Too quiet by the haystack; two more rounds.

lines.zh: 靴子踩过石板，声音传得很远。
lines.en: My boots on cobblestone carry a long way.

lines.zh: 火把该换了，我记下这根的位置。
lines.en: That torch needs replacing; I note where it stands.

lines.zh: 田埂上有人影，我压低肩膀过去。
lines.en: A shape on the ridge; I go low and forward.

lines.zh: 巡逻路线我闭着眼也走得对。
lines.en: I could walk this patrol route blindfolded.

lines.zh: 村庄这么大，一双眼睛不够用。
lines.en: The village is wide; one pair of eyes is thin.

lines.zh: 木门半开着，我停下把它推回去。
lines.en: A wooden door hangs open; I stop and push it shut.

lines.zh: 从东头到西头，天黑前要跑完。
lines.en: East end to west end before dark, no dawdling.

lines.zh: 鸡棚那边有响动，我拐了过去。
lines.en: Something stirs by the coop; I turn that way.

lines.zh: 盾牌背在身后，走起来有点沉。
lines.en: The shield on my back makes each step heavier.

lines.zh: 站直了，村口得有人一直看着。
lines.en: Stand tall; someone must always watch the gate.

lines.zh: 剑鞘松了，我把它重新系紧。
lines.en: The scabbard loosened; I cinch it tight again.

lines.zh: 今天没来袭击，反倒让人心里发毛。
lines.en: No raid today, which unsettles me more.

lines.zh: 我数了数，村里还剩七户人家。
lines.en: I count again: seven households remain.

lines.zh: 弩弦该上油了，拉起来有点涩。
lines.en: The bowstring needs oil; it drags when drawn.

lines.zh: 钟一响，我三息之内就到广场。
lines.en: When the bell rings, I reach the square in three breaths.

lines.zh: 那个傻子村民昨天还在追鸡。
lines.en: That nitwit villager was chasing chickens yesterday.

lines.zh: 有人往我手里塞了块面包，还热着。
lines.en: Someone pressed warm bread into my hand.

lines.zh: 盔甲扣带磨破了肩膀，先忍着。
lines.en: The armor strap rubs my shoulder; I endure it.

lines.zh: 夜里风大，我盯着那片黑树林。
lines.en: The night wind is strong; I stare at the dark treeline.

lines.zh: 巡逻和驻守，两边都得有人。
lines.en: Patrol and post, both need a body.

lines.zh: 我认得每一条进村的小路。
lines.en: I know every small path into this village.

lines.zh: 磨刀石在铁匠铺后面，我记着。
lines.en: The whetstone is behind the smithy; I remember.

lines.zh: 村庄英雄的旗子挂在广场上。
lines.en: The village hero's banner hangs over the square.

lines.zh: 站住，先把手从口袋里拿出来。
lines.en: Halt, take your hands out of your pockets first.

lines.zh: 你腰间那把剑，是给谁准备的？
lines.en: That sword at your belt, who is it for?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，直到你走出村界。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on you until you cross the boundary.

lines.zh: 你靴子上有沼泽的泥，从哪来？
lines.en: Swamp mud on your boots, where did you come from?

lines.zh: 别在铁傀儡面前晃，它不看玩笑。
lines.en: Don't loiter by the iron golem; it has no humor.

lines.zh: 你眼神往仓库那边飘了两次。
lines.en: Twice now your eyes have drifted to the storehouse.

lines.zh: 报上名字，我就让你过去。
lines.en: Give me a name and I'll let you pass.

lines.zh: 你手里那把弩，弦是新的。
lines.en: That crossbow in your hand has a fresh string.

lines.zh: 我认得常来的商队，你不是。
lines.en: I know the regular caravans; you are not one.

lines.zh: 屋里的孩子在看，你最好老实。
lines.en: The children are watching from the window; behave.

lines.zh: 你要找铁匠？往北走第三间。
lines.en: Looking for the smith? Third door north.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，退后两步。
lines.en: You stand too close; two steps back.

lines.zh: 我没睡，别想趁换岗溜进来。
lines.en: I haven't slept; don't slip in at the shift change.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在看我的剑，不是我的脸。
lines.en: You watch my sword, not my face.

lines.zh: 你的手一直没离开剑柄。
lines.en: Your hand has not left the hilt.

lines.zh: 我在这儿站了三年，你骗不了我。
lines.en: I have stood here three years. You cannot fool me.

lines.zh: 盔甲挡了大半，骨头没事。
lines.en: The armor took most of it; the bone holds.

lines.zh: 这道口子得回头缝上。
lines.en: That gash will need stitching later.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，脚没退。
lines.en: It hurts; my feet haven't moved.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我照样站着。
lines.en: Another blow and I'll still be standing.

lines.zh: 我咬住牙，把剑换到右手。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and shift the sword to my right hand.

lines.zh: 血渗进绑腿，先不管它。
lines.en: Blood seeps into the wrap; ignore it for now.

lines.zh: 你打中的是胸甲，不是我。
lines.en: You hit the chestplate, not me.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，把盾抬起来。
lines.en: I grunt once and raise the shield.

lines.zh: 这一下够我记你一阵子。
lines.en: That one will keep me remembering you a while.

lines.zh: 退到门边，重新站住。
lines.en: Fall back to the door and set my feet again.

lines.zh: 面包我收下，但岗不能离。
lines.en: I'll take the bread, but I won't leave my post.

lines.zh: 你若给弩箭，我记你一份人情。
lines.en: Bring me bolts and I'll owe you a favor.

lines.zh: 别用吃的换通行，规矩不换。
lines.en: Food won't buy passage; the rules don't bend.

lines.zh: 那块熟肉我留给换岗的同伴。
lines.en: That cooked meat goes to the one relieving me.

lines.zh: 你若给我一面盾，我能守更久。
lines.en: Give me a shield and I can hold longer.

lines.zh: 铁锭比面包实在，我这么说。
lines.en: Iron ingots beat bread; I say so plainly.

lines.zh: 你把箭袋放下，我数数够不够。
lines.en: Set the quiver down and let me count.

lines.zh: 我不馋，只是这汤实在香。
lines.en: I'm not greedy, that stew simply smells good.

lines.zh: 想让我跟你走，先去问村长。
lines.en: Want me to follow you? Ask the elder first.

lines.zh: 食物放下就走吧，别多话。
lines.en: Leave the food and go; no need for talk.

lines.zh: 让一让，我背着弩不好转身。
lines.en: Step aside; the crossbow makes turning awkward.

lines.zh: 门口太窄，让我先过去。
lines.en: The doorway's too narrow; let me pass first.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的胸甲，疼的是你。
lines.en: You walked into my chestplate; you'll feel it.

lines.zh: 靠边，我这条线不能断。
lines.en: Move to the side; I can't break this line.

lines.zh: 小心，剑尖朝外，别碰。
lines.en: Careful, the blade points out; don't touch it.

lines.zh: 慢点走，石板路滑。
lines.en: Slow down; the cobbles are slick.

lines.zh: 你挡着我看巷口了。
lines.en: You're blocking my view of the alley.

lines.zh: 六个人一起走，本来就不宽。
lines.en: Six of us abreast were never going to fit.

lines.zh: 退半步，我好在门边站定。
lines.en: Half a step back so I can take the doorway.

lines.zh: 盾牌磕到你了，我道个歉。
lines.en: My shield knocked you; you have my apology.

lines.zh: 我和她换了岗，一起守东门。
lines.en: She and I swapped shifts to hold the east gate.

lines.zh: 她守白天，我守夜里那段。
lines.en: She takes the day; I take the dark hours.

lines.zh: 两个警卫背靠背，视野才够。
lines.en: Two guards back to back, that's enough eyes.

lines.zh: 我们不用说话，一个手势就懂。
lines.en: We need no words; one gesture is enough.

lines.zh: 她磨剑的声音，我在巷子这头就听见。
lines.en: I hear her honing the blade from this end of the alley.

lines.zh: 换岗时递一壶水，就算打过招呼。
lines.en: Passing a water flask at shift change is greeting enough.

lines.zh: 她不笑，可箭从没射偏过。
lines.en: She never smiles, and her bolts never miss.

lines.zh: 一队六人，谁也不能落下。
lines.en: Six to a squad, and no one gets left behind.

lines.zh: 我信她的盾，她信我的背。
lines.en: I trust her shield; she trusts my back.

lines.zh: 等这趟巡逻完了，一起吃点东西。
lines.en: When this patrol ends, we eat together.

lines.zh: 地上有支断箭，捡回去还能削。
lines.en: A snapped arrow; I'll pick it up and re-carve it.

lines.zh: 这把掉落的铁剑，擦擦还能用。
lines.en: A dropped iron sword; a wipe and it serves.

lines.zh: 谁把盾落在路中间了？
lines.en: Who left a shield in the middle of the road?

lines.zh: 我捡起那袋面包，交给仓库。
lines.en: I pick up the bread sack and take it to the storehouse.

lines.zh: 铁片散了一地，我一枚枚拾。
lines.en: Iron scraps everywhere; I gather them one by one.

lines.zh: 有村民掉了胡萝卜，得还回去。
lines.en: A villager dropped carrots; they go back to him.

lines.zh: 这把弩的弦断了，先收着。
lines.en: This crossbow's string snapped; I'll keep it for now.

lines.zh: 石板缝里有枚绿宝石，谁丢的？
lines.en: An emerald in a crack, whose was it?

lines.zh: 我把捡到的东西都摆在广场。
lines.en: Everything I find goes on the square table.

lines.zh: 空瓶子也捡，路上会扎脚。
lines.en: Even empty bottles, they cut feet on the path.

lines.zh: 林子边有影子，我的剑先出鞘。
lines.en: A shape at the treeline; my sword leaves the sheath first.

lines.zh: 那东西朝牲口棚去了，跟上。
lines.en: It's heading for the pens, move.

lines.zh: 是掠夺者，吹号角叫醒全村。
lines.en: Pillagers, I sound the horn to wake the village.

lines.zh: 僵尸从坟那头聚起来了。
lines.en: Zombies are gathering past the graveyard.

lines.zh: 它在翻我的仓库门，我看见了。
lines.en: It's prying at my storehouse door; I saw it.

lines.zh: 风向不对，那味道是腐肉。
lines.en: The wind is wrong, that smell is rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 这只苦力怕贴得太近，太近了。
lines.en: That creeper is close, far too close.

lines.zh: 他先动手的，全村都看见了。
lines.en: He struck first, and the whole village saw.

lines.zh: 别让它摸到钟，钟一倒就乱。
lines.en: It must not reach the bell; lose the bell and we panic.

lines.zh: 弩举起来，等它再走两步。
lines.en: Crossbow up; let it take two more steps.

lines.zh: 手别抖，五十步内我打得中。
lines.en: Steady, inside fifty paces I don't miss.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，我呼吸就慢一分。
lines.en: With every step it takes, my breathing slows.

lines.zh: 我在等它转身，好瞄准后颈。
lines.en: I wait for it to turn so I can aim at the neck.

lines.zh: 剑握低些，别让它看见距离。
lines.en: Hold the sword low so it misjudges the reach.

lines.zh: 它跳一下，我就往后挪半步。
lines.en: If it lunges, I give half a step.

lines.zh: 三、二、一，弦拉满了。
lines.en: Three, two, one, the string is at my cheek.

lines.zh: 它怕火，我把火把举高些。
lines.en: It fears fire; I raise the torch higher.

lines.zh: 我的靴子钉在石板上，不动。
lines.en: My boots are planted on the slab; I don't shift.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯住它的肩膀，不是牙。
lines.en: Watch its shoulders, not its teeth.

lines.zh: 它迟疑了，这一瞬就是破口。
lines.en: It hesitates, and that instant is the opening.

lines.zh: 剑劈下去，火星溅到石板。
lines.en: The blade comes down; sparks scatter on the stone.

lines.zh: 弩箭出膛，扎进它肩窝。
lines.en: The bolt flies and buries in its shoulder.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，用盾把它的爪挡开。
lines.en: I slam in, catching its claws on my shield.

lines.zh: 剑背敲它膝盖，让它跪下。
lines.en: I crack the flat of my blade across its knee.

lines.zh: 退一步，再刺，别让它抱住。
lines.en: Back a step, thrust again, don't let it grab.

lines.zh: 它抓住了我的剑，我拧腕抽回。
lines.en: It grips my blade; I twist my wrist and pull free.

lines.zh: 这一剑我练了三百遍。
lines.en: I have drilled this cut three hundred times.

lines.zh: 它倒地了，我补上一记。
lines.en: It goes down, and I finish the swing.

lines.zh: 盾牌压下去，别让它起来。
lines.en: Shield down on it; don't let it rise.

lines.zh: 别站在它爪子的范围里。
lines.en: Don't stand inside the reach of those claws.

lines.zh: 我们六个人一起在村口醒来。
lines.en: Six of us wake at the village gate together.

lines.zh: 剑已经握在手里，和出生时一样。
lines.en: The sword is already in my hand, as at birth.

lines.zh: 有人在敲钟，我朝广场走。
lines.en: Someone is ringing the bell; I head for the square.

lines.zh: 又有村庄需要人守了。
lines.en: Another village needs a guard, then.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，第一件事是数屋顶。
lines.en: I open my eyes and count the rooftops first.

lines.zh: 铁剑在鞘里响了一声，算答到。
lines.en: The iron sword rasps in its sheath, that's my answer.

lines.zh: 木栅栏还没修好，我先过去。
lines.en: The palisade isn't finished; I go there first.

lines.zh: 有人把盾塞进我左手里。
lines.en: Someone pressed a shield into my left hand.

lines.zh: 我认得这片田，像从前来过。
lines.en: I know this field, as though I've been here before.

lines.zh: 第六个位置站满了，队齐了。
lines.en: The sixth place fills; the squad is whole.

lines.zh: 别用火，村里的房子是木头。
lines.en: Not fire, the village houses are wood.

lines.zh: 屋顶的瓦滑，我摔了个结实。
lines.en: The tiles were slick; I landed hard.

lines.zh: 我不会游，这条渠太深了。
lines.en: I can't swim; this channel runs deep.

lines.zh: 苦力怕，我听见那声嘶了。
lines.en: A creeper; I heard that hiss.

lines.zh: 箭从墙后射来，没打招呼。
lines.en: The arrow came from behind the wall without warning.

lines.zh: 这味道不对，是女巫的手。
lines.en: This sting is wrong, a witch's work.

lines.zh: 三天没吃，剑都提不稳。
lines.en: Three days unfed; the sword wavers.

lines.zh: 雷打在钟楼上，我半边麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the bell tower; half of me is numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没石板了，我抓住边缘。
lines.en: No stone under my feet; I catch the ledge.
